niche: Avant-Garde Monumental Jewelry, Corporeal Sculptures & Raw Mineral Talismans
universe_description: Founded between Paris and Bali by sculptor and artist Evan Sugerman, Parts of Four treats jewelry as monumental sculptural talismans. Defying classic high-jewelry tropes, P4 works raw, tactile materials: hand-dipped acid-blackened sterling silver, solid cast yellow sun brass, petrified wood, sliced raw diamond slabs, and monolithic mega-pavé stone settings.
